title: Registration matching compares the 512-byte focused command summary, so a focused command over 512 bytes never matches its own registration
outcome: At a Claude Bash background task's end, registration matching compares the line's decoded focused argv with the run's full recorded focused argv read from request.json, not with the bounded 512-byte display summary, so a focused command longer than 512 bytes whose words are equal is matched and settles.
acceptance: observe_test_command_artifact_from's registration-focused comparison uses the complete focused argv from the run's request (bounded only by the request read limit), so a direct focused launcher line whose focused command exceeds 512 bytes attaches its sole matching terminal registration and settles, while differing words still refuse with ArtifactRequestMismatch; shown by a behaviour test with a command over 512 bytes. The Dart lane's existing comparison is unchanged unless reviewed separately.
